wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 12-003 wires the save/load slot UI via one src/vanilla facade (wireSaveSlotUi.ts) re-exporting the read-only define-save-directory-policy (6 doomsav<N>.dsg slots, temp.dsg staging, save dir policy), implement-save-slot-descriptions (24-byte description codec, 23 printable-ASCII user chars, EMPTY label, isVanillaSaveSlotEmpty), and the SAVESTRINGSIZE + MenuAction save/load vocabulary from src/ui/menus.ts. VANILLA_SAVE_SLOT_UI_INVARIANTS pins five rules (6 dsg slots; temp.dsg staging; 24-byte/23-char printable description; EMPTY empty-slot label; slot-select/quicksave/quickload/save-name-entry via 07-003 MenuAction kinds). The focused test exercises the real slot-filename policy + recognizer round-trip, the description encode/decode round-trip, empty-slot labelling, the constants, the multi-line-tolerant ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax). Only src/ui/menus.ts is importer-tracked among the re-exported modules (the src/save modules are not importer-tracked).
